title: Page layout with CSS grid and flexbox
when: The user needs columns, a sidebar layout, a card grid, centering or a footer that stays at the bottom, or a layout that breaks on small screens.
inputs: how many columns on wide screens
prompt:
Goal: A layout that adapts from 320 px to wide screens, grid for two dimensions and flex for one, with no horizontal scroll.
Steps:
1. Reset: *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box }, body { margin: 0 }, img { max-width: 100%; height: auto }.
2. Page frame: body { display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto; min-height: 100dvh } keeps the footer at the bottom.
3. Content width: .container { width: min(100% - 2rem, 70rem); margin-inline: auto }.
4. Card grids: grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(16rem, 100%), 1fr)) with gap, no media query needed.
5. Sidebar: one column by default, grid-template-columns: 16rem 1fr inside @media (min-width: 48rem).
6. Rows (toolbar, tags, nav): flex with flex-wrap: wrap and gap; push one item right with margin-inline-start: auto; center with display: grid; place-items: center.
Quality bar:
- Spacing comes from gap, not margins on children.
- Visual order matches source order for keyboard users.
- Long URLs wrap (overflow-wrap: anywhere).
Pitfalls:
- Fixed pixel widths that overflow at 375 px.
- Floats or absolute positioning for columns.
- height: 100vh on phones, which hides content under the toolbars.
Verify:
- [ ] border-box reset present.
- [ ] An auto-fit grid or a min-width media query exists.
- [ ] No px width above 400 outside media queries.
- [ ] No sideways scroll at 320 px.
Output: style.css with commented layout blocks; the HTML uses the class names it defines.

examples.input: quero um layout com barra lateral e cards que se ajustem no celular
examples.output: body grid with header, main, footer; sidebar from 48rem; auto-fit card grid with minmax(16rem, 1fr)
